## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

widgets_values: <Subject 1>: An anime-style girl with ash mint-green hair tied in high twin ponytails with teal hair accents, a small hairpin on her bangs, a black cat-ear headband with a white frilled maid headpiece, and calm amber eyes. Outfit: a black short-sleeve puff top under a white maid apron with ruffled edges, a red necktie, a navy ruffled mini skirt with layered white petticoat frills, black garter straps, white thigh-high stockings with black trim, chunky white leg warmers with red ribbon bows, black-and-white sneakers with neon-green accents, and black wrist cuffs. Signature prop: a red backpack with a "3/4" label patch and a white cartoon face emblem, with a pair of small white feathered wings attached to the backpack that glow soft cyan at the edges. Appearance source: <Picture 1>, which is a character turnaround sheet showing the SAME single character from front, left side, right side and back views; use it only to understand her complete 360-degree appearance. Generate exactly ONE instance of this character, never multiple copies. Keep the hair color, cat ears, maid apron, red tie, red winged backpack, leg warmers and sneakers consistent in every frame, with no anatomy distortion and no feature leakage from the reference performer. <Subject 2>: The futuristic city plaza shown in the background of <Picture 1>: a wide open plaza paved with large light-grey stone tiles leading to a massive grand stone staircase with metal handrails along both sides, flanked by tall modern buildings with dark facades, cyan-green neon strip lighting and glowing pink and blue digital signboards, tall slim structures with rotor-like tops at the top of the staircase, a clear bright blue sky with scattered white clouds, crisp daylight from a high sun casting sharp, defined shadows on the stone tiles. <Subject 3>: The full motion performance extracted from <Video 1>, including the complete limb sequence, exact timing, rhythm and tempo of the source dance. Only inherit the motion logic; do not copy the appearance, face, body shape, clothing or environment of the performer in <Video 1>. summary: "[reference generation] <Subject 1> performs the full dance routine of <Subject 3> within {{TIME_RANGE}} seconds, output video duration {{DURATION_SEC}} seconds, aspect ratio {{ASPECT_RATIO}}. The scene environment is fully defined by <Subject 2>." retention_analysis: target_subject_appearance: fully_preserved <Subject 3> (dance, movement, timing): weak_reference - use only its choreography, rhythmic timing, pose transitions and full-body scale; do not retain its dancer, clothing, original scene or lighting. motion_behavior: attribute_transfer, transfer timing, tempo and body-movement sequence from <Subject 3> onto <Subject 1> camera_path: do not inherit any camera movement from <Video 1>; use the fixed camera defined below. detailed_description: A full-body anime dance performance in a polished anime illustration style, set in the futuristic city plaza from <Subject 2>. <Subject 1> stands on the stone-tile plaza in front of the grand staircase, naturally integrated into the scene with matching high-sun lighting from above, real ground contact, natural cast shadows on the tiles, correct perspective and scale. Recompose the scene for the {{ASPECT_RATIO}} frame: the grand staircase rises in the center background, the neon-lit buildings frame both sides, blue sky with clouds at the top. Keep sufficient clear floor space around the dancer. Her twin ponytails, skirt frills and backpack wings react naturally to her movement with physically plausible secondary motion. Do not generate subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, the text "RunningHub AI生成", interface graphics or any additional text, and do not show the turnaround-sheet layout or split panels. [Shot 1] Scene setting: Bright daytime on the open stone plaza at the foot of the grand staircase, neon signs glowing softly in daylight, a few distant flying vehicles drifting across the sky. Keep the background stable and uncluttered so detail is spent on the character's movement. <Subject 1> stays centered in frame and performs the full movement set of <Subject 3> strictly from {{TIME_RANGE}} seconds, following the original tempo and rhythm exactly, executing every beat of the choreography from <Video 1> in its original order without omitting or adding moves. Camera instruction: Fixed camera at chest height, straight-on front view, full-body framing with a small margin above the head and below the feet, no zoom, no pan, no cuts. Never crop her hands, feet, ponytails or backpack wings. No facial or bodily appearance copying from the performer in <Video 1>. Maintain a stable silhouette, colors and signature props of <Subject 1> throughout the clip; avoid melting joints, extra limbs, flickering details or sudden feature drifting. overall_soundscape: Light open-air city ambience, a soft breeze, rhythmic sneaker footsteps and light taps on the stone tiles synced to her dance steps, faint rustle of skirt frills. non_diegetic_music: An upbeat, bright electronic J-pop dance track whose beat and tempo match the rhythm of the dance in <Video 1>, no vocals, clean mix.
